verses.text: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a message was revealed to Daniel, who was also called Belteshazzar. The message was true, and it was about a great war. Daniel understood the message, and he understood the vision.
At that time I, Daniel, mourned for three whole weeks.
I ate no rich food. No meat or wine touched my lips. I used no lotions at all until the three weeks were over.
On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris.
I looked up, and there before me was a man dressed in linen, with a belt of the finest gold around his waist.
His body was like topaz, his face like lightning, and his eyes like flaming torches. His arms and legs shone like polished bronze, and his voice sounded like the roar of a crowd.
I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision. The men who were with me did not see it, but they were so terrified that they ran away and hid.
So I was left alone, looking at this great vision. I had no strength left. My face turned deathly pale, and I was helpless.
Then I heard him speaking. As I listened to him, I fell into a deep sleep, lying face down on the ground.
A hand touched me and set me, trembling, on my hands and knees.
He said, "Daniel, you are greatly loved. Think carefully about the words I am going to speak to you. Stand up, because I have now been sent to you." When he said this to me, I stood up, trembling.
Then he said, "Do not be afraid, Daniel. From the first day that you decided to gain understanding and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come in answer to them.
But the prince of the kingdom of Persia blocked my way for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, because I was being held there with the kings of Persia.
Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the days to come, because the vision is about a time yet to come."
While he was saying this to me, I bowed with my face toward the ground and could not speak.

Then one who looked like a human being touched my lips. I opened my mouth and began to speak. I said to the one standing in front of me, "My lord, I am overcome with pain because of the vision, and I have no strength left.
How can I, your servant, talk with you, my lord? My strength is gone, and I can hardly breathe."
Again the one who looked like a man touched me and gave me strength.

He said, "Do not be afraid, you who are greatly loved. Peace be with you! Be strong now. Be strong." When he spoke to me, I felt stronger, and I said, "Speak, my lord, since you have given me strength."
So he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? Soon I will go back to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I leave, the prince of Greece will come.
But first I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. No one supports me against them except Michael, your prince.
